TextBlock.Text: DARWIN APPROACHES, July 1988. Exercise PITCH BLACK's maritime phase, with an American carrier group south of the Arafura and a mixed aggressor force flying the other side's profiles. A Bear G is running the maritime strike serial with a Badger tanker behind it, a Dragon Lady is high over the exercise box, and the Nighthawk detachment is flying its first Southern Hemisphere sortie with the F-8s of the aggressor squadron as its problem. This is an exercise. It is also the only place in this collection where a Tomcat, an F-117, a Tornado and a Bear G share a sky without somebody having to invent a reason.
Serial: Defeat the maritime strike serial Recovery: Recover the exercise aircraft Umpire: Stay inside the exercise rules
F-14A and F-117 detachments, a B-52G, a U-2, an Italian Tornado detachment on exchange. Aggressors: J-8, Tu-16N, Tu-95 Bear G.
60 minutes. The operation ends when the clock runs out, and the main objective fails with it.

F-117 Nighthawk, Italian Navy Mod, B-52G with AGM-86 (realistic nuke), U-2 "Dragon Lady", Flight Deck Ops, A-10A Thunderbolt II, Tu-95K-22 Bear G MOD, <<Tu-16N>>, Shenyang J-8, Custom Loadout Editor, the base game.
